name: step3_pcr_mw_feasibility_incident_001
failure: ZeroDivisionError while summarizing non-finite auxiliary-to-safety ratios
diagnosis: The frozen manual FP16 loss scale 65536 caused non-finite safety or mean-worst branch gradients on 9 of 16 rows. PCR-M gradients were nonzero on all 16 rows. The summary code then divided by zero instead of recording a STOP result.
recovery: Permit one prospective from-scratch numerical recovery with identical data, loss, window, thresholds, and model initialization; set manual gradient scale to 1 because trainable LoRA gradients accumulate in FP32, and make non-finite summary handling fail closed.
